title: Correlation and causation identifiers
description: Workflow-tracing identifiers for messages, events, and records. A correlation ID names one logical workflow or user action and is shared by every message that belongs to it; a causation ID names the exact message or event that directly produced this one. Both reuse the stable-identifier grammar and are opaque. Consumers must treat them as trace metadata only — they never carry authorization or ordering semantics on their own.
